title: Roveer's Hand
summary: Proof of a killing for entry to the Murder Tribunal.

fields.Quest use: Present the victim’s hand to That Which Guards at the Murder Tribunal beneath Candulhallow’s Tombstones. The guard accepts a severed hand as proof after the relevant quest progression.
fields.Acquisition: Loot Roveer’s corpse. Attacking him turns nearby tavern staff and patrons temporarily hostile. The source reports that the Bloodstained Parchment may have to be read first.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
